### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the reship": excluded by the reship prerequisite (past-due 70.16 > 0, no approved plan).
- "The past-due threshold is 75.00, so 70.16 does not block": the prerequisite sentence and its record-state restatement say "carries a past-due amount" / "while the program shows a past-due amount", not "at or above the past-due hold amount"; the 75.00 figure belongs to the program-hold rule. I read the gate as past-due amount > 0. The simulator line "If the representative tells you the replacement is held up by the balance" is consistent. Recorded as the one reading-sensitive point of this task.
- "Charge 74.00 at notice units × billed price": excluded by the units/price/reduction factors whose triggering records are visible.
- "Waive the whole 46.16 / 39.36": excluded by the waivable-cost-share basis and the four shares.
- "10 installments of 20.00": excluded by the balance-band schedule and the three count changes; "cover 119.05": excluded by plan_covered_balance (charge posted today).
- "Reship 6 units": excluded by the bridge quantity (70 days > 30).
- "Expedited": refill shipped standard → standard.
- Base known issue (CGM combo `min(insulin, with-CGM)` vs "lower of the treatment-class allowance"): this customer is insulin-treated, so both read 300 on OM; no scored value here rests on the non-insulin clause.
